note_en: 一边……一边…… describes two actions happening at the same time, like English "while": 吃的时候要一边小心地吹气，一边轻轻咬开一个小口 "as you eat, blow on it carefully while gently biting a small hole." Unlike "while," 一边 is repeated before each verb, and the two actions are treated as equal partners.
